extraFields.label: Private health insurance
extraFields.help: Your monthly hospital and/or extras cover premium after the government rebate. Optional, but many people hold hospital cover to avoid the Medicare levy surcharge.

single.note: Average hospital + extras policy about $3,560 a year (~$300 a month) per Compare the Market 2025 data; singles often pay less on basic/bronze cover. Estimate.

suburban.note: Family hospital + extras cover; no direct family average found. Estimate.

youngpro.note: Couple or single hospital + extras cover; estimate.

localTips.title: Compare your electricity plan on Energy Made Easy
localTips.why: Many households are on plans priced at or near the Default Market Offer, while market offers from the same or other retailers are often cheaper.
tips: Upload your bill to Energy Made Easy (or Victorian Energy Compare in Victoria) to see cheaper plans for your actual usage.
Ask your current retailer to match the best offer before switching.
If you have solar or can shift usage, compare time-of-use plans with cheap midday rates.

pct.note: Assumed saving from switching to a market offer; estimate.

localTips.title: Review your private health cover tier and extras
localTips.why: Premiums rise every April, and many people pay for extras or hospital services they never use.
tips: Compare policies on privatehealth.gov.au, the government’s free comparison site.
Check whether you use your extras enough to beat the premium; if not, drop extras or pick a cheaper tier.
A higher excess lowers the premium; consider paying annually before 1 April to lock in the old price.

pct.note: Assumed saving from changing tier/excess; estimate.
